phase3.gigsHelp.en: Short local jobs. Check parole conditions with your officer. Phone numbers are never shown.
phase3.gigsHelp.draft: Imirimo yoroheje yo mu gace k'iwacu, kugenzura imimerere y'ifungurwa ry'agateganyo n'umupolisi wawe, umubare wa telefoni ntiwigera ugaragazwa.

phase3.housingHelp.en: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.housingHelp.draft: Intego zo kuzigama hamwe na gahunda yo kwitegura inzu. Groundwork ntabwo itanga inzu kandi ntabwo ifitanye ubufatanye n'abatanga. Ku bw'ubufasha bw'aho utuye, hamagara 211.

phase3.paidNote.en: Paid plan. No price has been set yet.

phase3.parole.draft: Gushyira mu bikorwa amabwiriza yo gufungurwa by'agateganyo

phase3.tokensHelp.draft: Ibyo biceri nta gaciro bifite mu mafaranga.

reentry.crisisStep.en: Save these numbers now. You can also tap Need help now at the top of any screen.
reentry.crisisStep.draft: Urashobora kandi gukanda ku Dukeneye ubu ubufasha hejuru y'urupapuro urwo ari rwo rwose.

reentry.steps.step14.en: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar
reentry.steps.step14.draft: Jya ushyira amatariki yose y'urubanza ku kalendari

reentry.steps.step17.en: Check your fines, fees and restitution
reentry.steps.step17.draft: Reba amafaranga y'amande, amafaranga y'ishyuzwa n'ayo kwishyura

reentry.steps.step19.en: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it
reentry.steps.step19.draft: Jya kuri Medicaid, kandi niba uyikeneye, ujye uyikoresha

reentry.steps.step7.en: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
reentry.steps.step7.draft: Shaka ahantu heza ho kuba (hamagara 211 cyangwa ahantu ho gutura)

reentry.steps.step8.en: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
reentry.steps.step8.draft: Shaka ibyokurya by'iki cyumweru (hamagara 211 cyangwa ikigega cy'ibyokurya cyo mu karere k'iwanyu)

safety.relapseDraft.en: Draft — for review. Calm first steps for the first 24 hours after a slip will appear here once reviewed. You are not alone.
safety.relapseDraft.draft: Igishushanyo  ⁇  cyo gusuzuma. Intambwe za mbere zitekanye mu masaha 24 ya mbere nyuma yo gusimbuka zizagaragara hano umaze gusuzuma. Si wowe wenyine.

safety.vaultHelp.en: Your documents are encrypted. Paid plan feature; no price has been set yet.
safety.vaultHelp.draft: Inyandiko zawe zashyizwemo kode. Gahunda yishyurwa; nta giciro cyashyizweho.

support.resourcesNote.en: Legal aid, treatment and transit. This directory does not cover food or housing.

wellbeing.roughHelp.en: You are not alone. The crisis button above is always here — call or text 988, or 911 in an emergency.
wellbeing.roughHelp.draft: Si wowe wenyine. Agasanduku k'ibibazo kari hejuru gahora aha  ⁇  hamagara cyangwa wandikire ubutumwa bugufi 988, cyangwa 911 mu gihe habaye ikibazo cy'ingorabahizi.

work.paroleNote.en: Check your parole or probation conditions with your officer before applying.
work.paroleNote.draft: Jya ubanza usuzume imimerere y'igifungo cyawe cy'agateganyo cyangwa cy'agateganyo ubiganiraho n'umukozi wawe mbere yo gusaba.
